📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-04-25-ms-preferences-internal-tag-dependency`  •  🔴 *LIVE swat — platform-wide sign-in/sign-up outage*
Occurrence #2 overall (1st recurrence since the 2026-04-25 original). Customer-facing impact ~12:55–13:05 UTC (~10 min); engineers report recovery at 13:04 UTC.

*What happened:* a morning release of *ms-preferences-api* (engineer-confirmed mid-deploy in #swat) broke sign-in, sign-up, and screen loads platform-wide ("constant white screen"). Same shape as PL-62401: ms-preferences ships before its 9 dependent upstream services are updated → their calls fail → gateway 5XX flood. Alexander Ballard in-thread: _"Last time deployed preferences in the morning it lead to an outage."_

*Playbook:* 1) Confirm ms-preferences-api was in the morning release set and whether [AllowInternal]/[AllowIdentity] internal-route tags shipped ahead of upstream caller updates. 2) Mitigation: roll back ms-preferences-api (or whichever security-hardened service shipped first). 3) PIR action (still open): dependency-heavy ms-preferences releases must be DevOps+Lead reviewed and scheduled *outside business hours*.
*Open Jira:* PL-62401

🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 3 · swat-bypass)
Channel: #swat  •  bug-type guess: env (DNS/domain)  •  alerts in group: 4

Symptoms:
  - 4 customers get the browser "The site can't be reached" page when following Method short links (MIURLs) — e.g. a "free hour" customer email link. Account named: ebamethod.
  - Connection-level failure (browser can't connect), not an in-app error → the short-link domain itself isn't resolving/serving.
  - Manan: same symptom hit #help-support yesterday (2nd consecutive day).

Likely cause: The MIURL short-link domain was switched off miurl.cc to an alternate that's unreachable. legacy-miurl-api generates miurl.com/{hash}mI short URLs; a recent domain change is the regression — not a code/server fault (miurl isn't in Datadog; DD miurl query = 0 results).

Team is already on it — Arash → John Miranda ("Yes let's switch over") → Richard Pangborn ("yes") reached consensus ~19:42–19:50Z to revert the short-link domain back to miurl.cc. Heavy operator engagement (−3), so this is FYI/confirm, not a page.

Suggested next action: Confirm the miurl.cc revert lands and resolves the 4 reports; then add an external HTTP synthetic on the live MIURL domain. Keep miurl.cc as a permanent fallback.

Seeded KB entry ki-2026-06-16-miurl-shortlink-domain-unreachable (fix_status: mitigation-in-progress-revert-to-miurl-cc, conf 0.86).
